operator_authorization: 11.10.2026: «Du skal ha API fra Oanda for å hente inn mer info» og regel 1 åpnet for navngitte instrumenter som forskningsinputs og forskningsmål. Lesetilgang til historiske candles kun; ingen ordre, ingen kontoendring, ingen hemmelighet i logg eller kvittering.
client: gx1.execution.oanda_client.OandaClient.get_candles (existing read owner); credentials from .env via load_oanda_credentials; environment practice

step_1_instrument_inventory.purpose: Verify the exact instrument names below before any candle request; unknown names are dropped from the manifest, never guessed.
step_1_instrument_inventory.writes: INSTRUMENTS.json with name, type, displayName, pipLocation, marginRate only

candles.alignment_rationale: 17:00 New York is the canonical daily close used by the XAU D1 research clock (session end); the exact mapping to the canonical XAU D1 session_open/decision_time is verified row by row in the join, never assumed.

receipts: Per instrument: request parameters, HTTP status, candle count, first/last time, SHA-256 of the canonical JSON response and of the written parquet; no token or account id in any receipt.
data_contract: Columns time, open, high, low, close, volume for mid, plus bid/ask open/close. Non-finite, non-monotonic or duplicated times fail closed. Missing days are recorded, never filled.
availability_rule: A daily candle closing at alignment hour on day D is usable at the first canonical XAU D1 decision at or after that close plus the declared one-session lag; same rule as the macro components.

previous_attempt.outcome: failed closed on missing test_seal_utc after one instrument-inventory GET; INSTRUMENTS.json retained as evidence (123 instruments, all 12 candidates listed); no candle request, no order
